Select distinct compound ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES for molecules reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs filtered by doc_chembl_id. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return columns chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
